pages.text: The disruptor taught me how to catch the glimmer. I placed the same Ender Pearl interference structure in a chamber: it now confines collected aether instead of waiting for water to form.

pages.title: Extract beside the crafting table
pages.text: Place it beside a reservoir, or feed it with pulses or a resonance branch. Empty-hand use extracts one fragment; sneak-use extracts up to sixteen, normally costing 200 each.$(br2)The countdown begins on extraction. Build reserves and prepare materials first, rather than timing every recipe around slow collection.

pages.title: A fleeting form
pages.text: An Ender Pearl gathers aether only briefly. Extracted fragments still fade. This chamber neither charges jars nor creates its own aether.$(br2)To keep that light for longer, you need a true nucleus: a Nether Star.
